Русскій Кооперативъ О-ва Отвѣтственныхъ Бухгалтеровъ
COOPERATIVE STORE OF THE RUSSIAN ACCOUNTANTS' ASSOCIATION
360, Route Cardinal Mercier, Tel. 78966
（批：Mr. Von der Crone to see Mr. Walini）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY No. 1483 21/3/42）

HEAD OFFICE:
339, Route Cardinal Mercier
Tel. 73839

Shanghai, 10th March 1942

The Chairman,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

（批：R. O. 17/3/42 +）

Sir,

In consideration of the prevailing living conditions and with a view to assuring its members and their families, numbering about 1000 persons, a regular supply of products of first necessity, which can hardly be obtained at present on the market, the Russian Accountants' Association has opened a Cooperative Store at 360, Route Cardinal Mercier under the name of:
"Cooperative Store of the Russian Accountants' Association".

From the enclosed Articles of Association you will kindly see that the Russian Cooperative does not have for its object purely commercial aims, as the main part of the profit gained from the trade is being returned to the consumers in the form of a premium on their purchases.

The Management of the Russian Cooperative begs also to bring to your knowledge that it is their sincere wish to assist, as far as possible, the Municipal authorities in distribution through their store of products of first necessity, in strict conformity with existing rules and regulations. The distribution of all and every product through the Russian Cooperative can be easily controlled, as all the purchases made by the members of

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER）

Русскій Кооперативъ О-ва Отвѣтственныхъ Бухгалтеровъ
俄罗斯会计师协会合作社商店
梅神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）360号，电话：78966
（批注：Von der Crone 先生去见 Walini 先生）
（印章：上海公共租界警务处登记处 第1483号 1942年3月21日）

总办事处：
梅神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）339号
电话：73839

上海，1942年3月10日

致：
上海工部局主席，
上海。

（批注：R. O. 1942年3月17日 +）

先生：

鉴于当前的生活状况，并为了确保其成员及其家属（约1000人）能定期获得目前市场上难以买到的生活必需品，俄罗斯会计师协会已在梅神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）360号开设了一家合作社商店，名称为：
“俄罗斯会计师协会合作社商店”。

从随附的章程中您可以看到，该俄罗斯合作社并非纯粹以商业为目的，因为贸易所得利润的大部分将以购买奖金的形式返还给消费者。

俄罗斯合作社管理层谨此告知，他们真诚希望在严格遵守现行规章制度的前提下，通过其商店协助市政当局分发生活必需品。通过俄罗斯合作社分发的所有产品均易于管控，因为会员的所有购买行为均记录在

（印章：上海公共租界警务处处长）

pages.en:
- 2 -

the Cooperative are recorded in individual consumers' books, which
fact eliminates entirely the possibility of speculation and abuse.

The Management of the Russian Cooperative would be very
grateful to you if you will be kind enough to inform the Director
of the Police and Municipal food supply and price control depart-
ments regarding the opening of the Russian Cooperative, its aim
to serve the community and its possibility of serving as a distri-
bution store.

Moreover, it is earnestly desired that the authorities in
question be cognizant of the fact that the store is not an ordinary
commercial provision shop making profits for accounts of buyers,
but a cooperative organisation, wherein the main acting person
is the consumer himself, who is at the same time co-owner of the
enterprise.

Trusting that this letter will receive your kind attention
and thanking you in advance for your assistance,

We are, Sir,

Yours faithfully,

RUSSIAN COOPERATIVE STORE

B. Elteev
Chairman

Secretary

（印：INDEXED BY (G.B.) REGISTRY DATE 9/13/42）

个人消费者账册中，这一事实完全消除了投机和滥用的可能性。

如果您能惠予通知警务处处长以及工部局粮食供应和物价管制部门关于俄罗斯合作社的开业情况、其服务社区的宗旨以及其作为分销商店的可能性，俄罗斯合作社管理层将不胜感激。

此外，迫切希望有关当局知悉，该商店并非一家为买家谋取利润的普通商业食品店，而是一个合作组织，其中主要的行动者即是消费者本人，他同时也是该企业的所有者之一。

相信此函能得到您的关注，并预先感谢您的协助，

此致，

敬礼，

俄罗斯合作社商店

B. Elteev
主席

秘书
